text:
maria (PM): quick thread to scope a mid-tier offering for RetailBank. they want predictable capacity for two hot routes, purchasable priority minutes, and a pilot SLA credit mechanic. no Dedicated. can we define a minimally viable commercial+tech path?
harry (Sales): customer will commit a monthly spend but refuses reserved GPUs. must haves: per-route predictability and a clear, measurable remedy if latency spikes.
todd (Pricing): product levers: per-route soft buckets billed per-minute, priority-minute packs, surge-window blocks. commercial = commit + premium for priority consumption. need a unit-econ spike.
lee (Eng): runtime can support a priority path + per-route token buckets. KV prefix pinning possible as a MVP with eviction rules; hard isolation requires Dedicated.
nina (Legal): if we do credits, we must set measurement method, cap credits (percent of monthly commit), carve-outs (maintenance/force majeure), and an EU data residency addendum if needed.
maria (PM): propose a 4-week pilot called "route-priority beta": - route-level soft QPS buckets (configurable) - priority-minute packs (consumable per-route) - automatic fallback to baseline model variant when tokens exhausted - SLA credit formula: minutes where p99 > target * credit unit; cap = min(monthly commit * 0.2, $cap). agree?
harry (Sales): sales +1. RetailBank accepts non-binding pilot SLA if SLOs are explicit and instrumented. they require route gating by id.
todd (Pricing): +1. will build three pricing scenarios once eng gives cost delta. propose a per-customer monthly cap and emergency shutoff.
lee (Eng): eng acceptance criteria: 1) runtime supports per-route token buckets and priority flag 2) KV-pinning MVP with documented mem limits 3) feature-flag rollout and canary. estimate spike 7-10d + 2 sprints.
ops-bot: reminder set: "route-priority pilot kickoff" 2026-06-01 14:00 UTC
nina (Legal): I'll draft a pilot addendum with credit cap = min(monthly commit, 20%) and include carve-outs.
maria (PM): acceptance checklist draft:
- product: API + console toggle to mark route priority
- eng: token buckets, priority path, KV pinning
- billing/infra: near-real-time meter for priority-minutes
- pricing: scenario bands + spend cap
- legal: pilot addendum + residency clause
- sales: signed pilot acceptance + list of route_ids
- observability: dashboard with p50/p95/p99 by route and priority consumption
harry (Sales): I'll get the signed pilot acceptance and route list today.
todd (Pricing): will run unit-econ scenarios and share numbers in 4 business days.
lee (Eng): will post spike notes + perf expectations in #eng-runtime after 10d.
maria (PM): thanks team. reconvene after spike to decide GA gates. :thumbsup:
